rebuild_target: Orchestrator-worker deep research agent on macOS 26

features.description: Project targets macOS 26 with Swift 6.2 strict concurrency
steps: Add swift-anthropic, MacPaw/OpenAI, mcp-swift-sdk, firebase-ios-sdk deps
Project builds cleanly with zero warnings

features.description: Single Sendable LLMProvider protocol covers streaming, tool calling, and structured output
steps: Define LLMProvider protocol with stream(messages:) -> AsyncThrowingStream<LLMChunk>
Define generate<T: Generable>(messages:as:) for structured output

features.description: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.1 via documented Messages API model IDs
steps: Supports SSE streaming via the Anthropic Messages API

features.description: OpenAI GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.4 family via direct REST
Google Gemini 3 Pro Preview / 3 Flash Preview / 2.5 Pro via direct REST
Local Ollama server provider with model picker
MLX-Swift on-device inference (Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek R1, etc.)
Apple Foundation Models on-device orchestrator brain
API keys stored in Keychain, not UserDefaults
ResearchSession / Source / Citation persisted via SwiftData
Multi-provider web search with fallback chain
Web content extraction handles JS-rendered pages
steps: Dynamic path: hidden WKWebView with evaluateJavaScript
Content trimmed to fit context window

features.description: Citations extracted with exact quotes and source URLs
steps: Each source chunk tagged with origin URL
Final draft references rendered as chips

features.description: Actor-based orchestrator dispatches parallel worker agents
steps: ResearchOrchestrator actor decomposes query into ≥2 sub-tasks
TaskGroup fans out worker actors in parallel
Workers emit progress events through shared AsyncThrowingStream
Orchestrator synthesizes final answer with citations
Token budget enforced; cancellation propagates cleanly

features.description: Single AsyncThrowingStream<ResearchEvent> drives all UI
steps: Event variants: planEmitted, workerStarted, toolInvoked, sourceFetched, tokenDelta, citationAdded, draftReady, error

features.description: MCP Swift SDK client wired in for dynamic tool extension
steps: Surface MCP tools as Tool protocol implementations

features.description: SessionList | ResearchCanvas | SourcePanel three-pane layout
steps: Canvas streams ResearchEvents into reasoning/draft groups
SourcePanel lists citations with hover preview

features.description: macOS 26 Liquid Glass on toolbars, source cards, settings sheet
Tokens stream live with collapsible reasoning groups
Settings sheet for provider selection + key entry + tool toggles
Document upload view embeds PDFs, notes, and pasted text into a local pyseekdb/seekdb vector knowledge base for research-time retrieval
steps: Document sheet opens from toolbar and keyboard shortcut
User can drop or choose PDFs, markdown, text, CSV, JSON, YAML, and HTML files
Sidecar chunks documents and stores embeddings in embedded or server-mode seekdb
Workers call `knowledge_base` before web search when enabled
Knowledge-base passages become first-class fetched sources for citation extraction

features.description: App builds via xcodebuild and launches; one full research run completes
steps: User can enter a query and see streaming response
